name: markdown-tab-icons
description: Adds icons to tab labels in VSCode's markdown preview, matched from the label (npm, pnpm, vite.config.ts) or named with a [!keyword] marker
author: Drake Costa <drake@saeris.io> (https://saeris.gg)

bumpy.buildCommand: vp pack && vp exec postcss src/tab-icons.css --output dist/tab-icons.css && vp exec vsce package --no-dependencies
